messages:
maria: Quick sync — trying to lock down audit-event naming + customer-facing schema for RBAC & KMS changes. Two quick asks: 1) canonical prefix we surface to customers, 2) how do we version without breaking downstream consumers, 3) which KMS ops do we actually emit (rotate/create/revoke/access)?
sam: +1. For prefix I prefer something stable and namespaced: `redwood.audit` or `redwood.security.audit` so customers can filter easily. Keep vendor prefix imo.
danielle: agree on namespacing. Also want to avoid leaking key material or PII in customer-facing events. We should only emit key ids (KMS key ARN or internal id), not raw material. Maybe redact user emails.
leo: for versioning we should NOT bake version into the event name (e.g., `kms.rotate.v2`). Use an explicit `schema_version` field and keep event `type` stable. That way filters by `type` still work and consumers can check `schema_version` for parsing.
product-ops: customers asked for stable event names to map to their SIEM. They prefer `redwood.audit.kms.key_rotate` and a `schema_version: "1"` field. Backwards compatibility is critical.
security-bot: FYI: current internal events are inconsistent: `kms.rotate`, `kms_key_rotated`, `key.rotation` across services. We need a one-time migration mapping table and a deprecation window.
mar ia: @sam @danielle ok — draft proposal: event_type examples: `redwood.audit.kms.key_rotate`, `redwood.audit.rbac.role_grant`, `redwood.audit.rbac.role_revoke`, `redwood.audit.kms.key_create`, `redwood.audit.kms.key_revoke`, `redwood.audit.kms.key_access`.
mar ia: include standard top-level fields: `event_type`, `schema_version`, `timestamp`, `actor`, `actor_id`, `customer_id`, `resource_type`, `resource_id`, `request_id`, `region`, `details`.
sam: + code sample would help. here's a compact example:

```
{
  "event_type": "redwood.audit.kms.key_rotate",
  "schema_version": "1",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-15T18:23:40Z",
  "actor": "service-account:dedicated-autoscaler",
  "actor_id": "svc-dedicated-autoscaler-01",
  "customer_id": "acct_abc123",
  "resource_type": "kms_key",
  "resource_id": "kms-xyz-0001",
  "request_id": "req_9876",
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "details": { "rotation_type": "scheduled", "previous_key_id": "kms-xyz-0000" }
}
```

danielle: that looks good. Change request: `actor` should be a short display string, never include email addresses. Add `actor_type` (human|service|infra) so customers can filter.
leo: also suggest `redwood_id` or hashed `resource_id` option for customers with stricter PII rules — we can emit both `resource_id` and `resource_id_hash` when requested via org config.
product-ops: how do we handle deprecations? customers will rely on `event_type`. If we follow `schema_version` approach we can change payloads w/out renaming `event_type` — but what about event semantics changes? need a deprecation policy and changelog.
mar ia: propose deprecation plan: announce in console + email, 90-day overlap where we emit both old and new event_type (tag old as `deprecated:true` in `details`), then remove old after 90 days.
security-bot: note: emitting both can double egress for heavy workloads. Ops needs to estimate cost.
leo: ops callout noted. Also KMS-specific: don't emit `previous_key_material` or `key_ring` internals. Only metadata.
sam: question re: RBAC events — do we include `before`/`after` snapshots for role changes or only the delta? Customers often want both for audit trails.
danielle: store full snapshots internally but only emit `delta` by default. Allow opt-in full snapshots for enterprise customers with retention/consent.
product-ops: customer-facing validation — we should add a small JSON Schema and publish it. Customers asked for a stable list of required fields and their types.
mar ia: agree. I'll draft JSON Schema and include examples + migration guide. Action items: maria -> create initial spec + sample events (due EOW). danielle -> write PII/redaction rules and opt-in behavior. leo -> estimate egress cost for emitting dual events. sam -> write JSON Schema draft for parsers. product-ops -> prepare customer comms template.
security-bot: audit-bot will emit a sample event when spec lands in `eng-runtime` branch for end-to-end test.
audit-bot: [automated] emitted test event: `redwood.audit.kms.key_rotate` in staging for acct_abc123 :eyes:
mar ia: cool — thanks all. will post spec link here once created. :thumbsup:
sam: :+1:
